hero.title: Your WordPress site, <hl>always up to date</hl> and checked by a daily scan
hero.sub: No need to hire a full-time site admin. Routine maintenance is automated, and you're asked for permission only when a decision is sensitive.
hero.pointNoCard: No bank card needed for pilot access
hero.previewSub: Shown here once your site is connected

updates.title: Always up to date
updates.desc: Core, plugins, and themes are updated to their latest versions automatically. In safe mode, these options can't be turned off.

malware.title: Malware scanning
malware.desc: A daily scan against an up-to-date signature database, plus hash lookups in external threat databases.

integrity.title: Core integrity check
integrity.desc: Every WordPress core file is compared with the official release; an unknown file in wp-includes is a finding in its own right.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.desc: Database dumps written in pure PHP — they work even on hosts where exec() is disabled — and only complete dumps are recorded.

conflict.title: Conflict finder
conflict.desc: Point it at your broken page: plugins and the theme are switched off group by group until the culprit is found, then everything is switched back on.

rescue.title: Rescue operations
rescue.desc: For a site whose files can no longer be trusted: replace them with the official versions instead of guesswork cleanup.

authority.title: Three levels of authority
authority.sub: Decide how much freedom your assistant has. Sensitive actions need your approval at every level.

report.title: Report only
report.desc: Only observes and suggests; nothing is changed on your site.

confirm.title: With approval
confirm.desc: Prepares the fix, waits for your approval, then applies and tests it.

auto.title: Automatic
auto.desc: Handles low-risk tasks on its own; sensitive actions still wait for your approval.

report.title: Tells you what happened, in plain language
report.sub: Every finding is reported in the same order — cause, recommended action, and status — with no claims about things that haven't happened yet.
report.alertBody: Core integrity check: a file in wp-includes does not match the official WordPress release.
report.causeValue: Not known yet — the file needs to be reviewed
report.actionValue: Rescue operation: replace it with the official WordPress version

agency.name: Agency
feats: Manage client sites from one panel

cta.title: Get peace of mind about your site, starting today
cta.sub: Pilot access — no bank card needed. Connect in under two minutes.
